key_insight: PANDA-D infers both advancing and receding dynamic contact angles directly from density and layerwise displacement, avoiding explicit interface extraction.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reproducible, automated wetting analysis in molecular simulations of moving contact lines and capillary flows.
method: Fit a circular-meniscus model to the liquid roll density profile.
Jointly fit density with layerwise center-of-mass displacement to resolve which side is advancing.
Estimate receding and advancing angles plus an effective near-wall offset without contour thresholds.
evidence_signal: On synthetic rolls the method achieved 0.29° RMS reconstruction error, and on Lennard-Jones rolls it matched independent circle-fit angles within 0.84° RMS.
watch_item: The approach assumes a circular-meniscus model, so accuracy may drop when real interfaces deviate strongly from that geometry or when density profiles are noisy.
paper_title: PANDA-D: Interface-free determination of two dynamic contact angles
